scripts.test: TS_NODE_PROJECT='./test/tsconfig.json' nyc mocha --bail --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register --require source-map-support/register --full-trace --delay --timeout 40000 './test/v1/**/*.spec.ts'
scripts.test:integration: INTEGRATION_LIVE=0 TS_NODE_PROJECT='./test/tsconfig.json' mocha --bail --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register --require source-map-support/register --full-trace --timeout 40000 './test/integration/**/*.spec.ts'
scripts.test:integration:live: INTEGRATION_LIVE=1 TS_NODE_PROJECT='./test/tsconfig.json' mocha --bail --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register --require source-map-support/register --full-trace --timeout 120000 './test/integration/**/*.spec.ts'
